name: DropdownItem
description: Describes one declarative item inside a dropdown or breadcrumb menu.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Sets the item label instead of using its text content.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Sets the value emitted when the item is selected.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Shows an icon before the label.

attributes.name: right-icon
attributes.description: Shows an icon after the label.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Renders the item as a link.

attributes.name: secondary-text
attributes.description: Adds compact secondary text beside the label.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Adds supporting text below the label.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Marks a checkable item as selected.

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: Marks a breadcrumb menu item as selected.

attributes.name: avatar
attributes.description: Shows an avatar before the label.

attributes.name: badge-label
attributes.description: Shows a badge with this label.

notes: Use this element inside noora-dropdown, noora-inline-dropdown, noora-button-dropdown, or noora-breadcrumb-item.
